Steps.Title: Add coffee powder
Steps.Hint: Coffee powder goes into the cloth sock first. Tap the sock filter.

Steps.Title: Pour hot water
Steps.Hint: Pour hot water from the kettle over the powder. Tap the kettle.

Steps.Title: Brew, then lift the sock
Steps.Hint: Let it brew, then lift the sock out of the pot. Tap the sock filter.

Steps.Title: Place the cup
Steps.Hint: Set a clean glass cup on the counter. Tap the cup.

Steps.Title: Add condensed milk
Steps.Hint: Add condensed milk to the bottom of the cup. Tap the condensed milk tin.

Steps.Title: Add sugar
Steps.Hint: Add a spoon of sugar into the cup. Tap the cup.

Steps.Title: Pour the kopi
Steps.Hint: Pour the brewed kopi from the pot into the cup. Tap the sock filter.

Steps.Title: Stir and serve
Steps.Hint: Stir until the milk mixes in, then serve. Tap the cup.
